name: AuditLog
description: Audit trail of business and security events — who did what to which resource, with structured context, status, and reason fields. Used for compliance reporting and post-incident debugging. ACL is admin-read only: admin can browse audit entries via the generic data API; writes happen through AuditService and the dedicated /audit endpoint.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the event in UTC. 'timestamptz' is ideal for storing Instant.

attributes.name: sourceUid
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the actor/initiator (user ID, system name, service ID).

attributes.name: idOfUser
attributes.description: Numeric ID of the user, if applicable and distinct from sourceUid.

attributes.name: actorIpAddress
attributes.description: IP address of the actor who performed the action.

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Severity/Category of the audit event (e.g., INFO, WARN, ERROR, CRITICAL).

attributes.name: summary
attributes.description: Concise human-readable summary of the action.

attributes.name: resourceType
attributes.description: The type of entity that was affected or acted upon (e.g., UserAccount, Document).

attributes.name: resourceId
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the specific resource that was affected.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Outcome of the action (SUCCESS or FAILURE).

attributes.name: reason
attributes.description: For 'FAILURE' status, a brief explanation of why the action failed.

attributes.name: context
attributes.description: JSON string containing additional name-value pairs for context (e.g., fileId, fileName, folderId).

attributes.name: detail
attributes.description: JSON string for more extensive details (e.g., stack trace, full payload difference).

attributes.name: taskId
attributes.description: ID for linking to specific background tasks or jobs.

attributes.name: txId
attributes.description: Unique UUID for correlating requests across services (transaction ID).
